thread:
maya: Hey — who grabbed my neon green travel mug? I left it on the counter at ~9 and now it has a Post-it that says 'temporarily claimed by mysterious sock'. :sob: If you borrowed it, confess and I will forgive with cookies.
ellie: Not me. Found a mug in conf-B that said 'do not steal my plant' and it had soil crumbs. Could that be yours?
sam: @maya I actually moved a mug off the upstairs couch this morning that had a tiny air plant shoved inside it. Left it in the sink with a 'returned by sam' note. Saw the Post-it too, mystery intensifies. :detective: 
ops-bot: kitchen-camera: footage gap recorded. reason: 'very important team bonding nap' at 02:12. :zzz: 
ryan: Mug registry whiteboard next to the sink? Everyone names their mug and we attach a sticker. Also enforce a 24-hour loan policy with mandatory cookie restitution. :white_check_mark:
maya: Mug registry = brilliant. I'll start the first entry: "Green mug — Maya — reward: 1 choc chip cookie"
ellie: Also: who made off with the Earl Grey tea bag stash? Found empty tin on the counter with a single sad string. tiny grief.
sam: Propose "Lost Mug Amnesty" on Friday. Bring any unclaimed mugs, stickers provided, guilt forgiven. :partyparrot:
maya: If my mug has a banana sticker on the handle, it's definitely mine. Send photos pls.
ellie: sending pic... (imagine a smug banana sticker) :banana:
ryan: We could also just label all mugs with paint pens like we did in 2022. That worked for 2 months. Then some mugs developed secret lives.
ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen labels are a community resource. Please do not use as coasters for wet shoes. :eyes: 
sam: Vote: mug registry + Lost Mug Amnesty + mandatory cookie bribe. All in favor emoji-react now. :raised_hands: :cookie: 
maya: Thanks y'all. If anyone spots a neon green mug with a banana sticker, I will pay in cookies and eternal gratitude. :pray:
